expected_symptom: dxc -P strips comments and there is no flag to keep them
reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet independent review (batch-012 step-10; blind 3414)
summary: Never implemented: comments are dropped by -P on all 20 stable releases and main, and -C/-CC are rejected as Unknown argument. The capability is already in the library - PrintPreprocessedOutput honours ShowComments/ShowMacroComments and CompilerInvocation parses -C/-CC on the cc1 path - but dxcompilerobj.cpp builds PreprocessorOutputOptions by hand and hardcodes both to 0, and HLSLOptions.td has no C/CC entry. So this is option plumbing, not a new capability, matching pow2clk's 2020 assessment.
title: Feature request: option to preprocess without removing comments
